title: Characterization of valid configuration records
statement: Fix a natural number $k$, state and tape-symbol types $Q$ and $T$, a natural number $s$, a Boolean input word $x$, and a finite list of lists of record symbols $fs$. The record $fs$ is valid for parameters $k$, $|x|$, and $s$ exactly when there are a configuration $c$ on input $x$ and a tag $\tau$ such that every work-tape head of $c$ lies within distance $s$ of the origin, every work-tape cell outside that window is blank, and the record of $c$ with tag $\tau$ is $fs$.
